error[ZBX-E0433]: no trash with that id
  while  looking for a trash
  cause  there is no trash 'bbbbbbbbbbbb'; it may have expired or been restored
  arg    bbbbbbbbbbbb
  fix    list the trash that is left:   zbx store gc --trash
  more   zbx explain E0433
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0433.html
